verdict.rationale: Google documents a self-serve supervised fine-tuning path for its Gemini models. Tuning jobs can be created via the console, REST, or the Google Gen AI SDK, and the page lists the supported models (Gemini 3.5 Flash/Flash-Lite, 3.1 Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro/Flash/Flash-Lite). The path sits on Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform rather than the ai.google.dev Gemini Developer API itself, and only supervised tuning is evidenced. Missing for 10: fine-tuning evidenced within the Gemini Developer API surface itself, tuning methods beyond supervised fine-tuning, tunable open weights, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights

citations.quote: This document describes how to tune a Gemini model by using supervised fine-tuning.
The page documents creating tuning jobs via console, REST, and the Google Gen AI SDK.
